name: Bits and Pieces
source:
Anthonii, a 19 year old video store worker, slowly loses feelings for his boyfriend Samúel. As he begins to hang out with others more and stray away from Samúel, he notices his boyfriend's odd behavior. The more he notices, the more he thinks his life, and others, may truly be in danger.

[From [url=https://softpilex.itch.io/bits-and-pieces]itch.io[/url]]
